package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestExactPathCommandsKeepPathIdentityInURLOnly(t *testing.T) {
	pathID := "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	for _, command := range []any{
		LearningPathReplan{LearningPathID: pathID},
		LearningPathCompletion{LearningPathID: pathID},
	} {
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(command)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var payload map[string]any
		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &payload); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, exists := payload["learning_path_id"]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("exact Student body leaked URL identity: %s", encoded)
		}
	}
}

func TestPlanningStateAcceptsProgressButRejectsSelectedPausedPath(t *testing.T) {
	state := validPlanningState()
	state.Items[0].Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
	if _, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(state); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("progressed owner state rejected: %v", err)
	}
	state.Status = "PAUSED"
	state.IsSelected = true
	if _, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(state); err != ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("selected paused path error=%v, want validation error", err)
	}
}

func validPlanningState() LearningPathPlanningState {
	return LearningPathPlanningState{
		Schema:    LearningPathPlanningStateSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", LearningPathID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1", Status: "ACTIVE", IsSelected: true,
		PathVersion: 3, JourneyVersion: 9, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1",
		ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Build a Go API", UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		Items: []LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Position: 0,
			Status: LearningPathItemReady, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}
}

func TestRevisionAssignmentsCanRepeatAndKeepDistinctOwnerIdentities(t *testing.T) {
	state := validPlanningState()
	state.Items[0].LearningPathItemID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	state.Items[0].LessonRevisionID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	second := state.Items[0]
	second.LearningPathItemID = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
	second.Position = 1
	second.Status = LearningPathItemPlanned
	state.Items = append(state.Items, second)
	got, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(state)
	if err != nil || got.Items[1].LearningPathItemID != second.LearningPathItemID || got.Items[0].LessonRevisionID != state.Items[0].LessonRevisionID {
		t.Fatalf("distinct revision assignments lost: %#v, %v", got, err)
	}
	state.Items[1].LearningPathItemID = state.Items[0].LearningPathItemID
	if _, err := NormalizeLearningPathPlanningState(state); err != ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate owner ID accepted: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNewRevisionReferencesAllowRepeatedAssignmentButLegacyReferencesStayDistinct(t *testing.T) {
	first := validPlanningState().Items[0]
	first.LessonRevisionID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	second := first
	second.Position, second.Status = 1, LearningPathItemPlanned
	if _, err := normalizeLearningPathItems([]LearningPathItem{first, second}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first.LessonRevisionID, second.LessonRevisionID = "", ""
	if _, err := normalizeLearningPathItems([]LearningPathItem{first, second}, false); err != ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("legacy duplicate error: %v", err)
	}
}
